items.headline: Nick Sessions' pick-6 on first play of game sparks New Mexico State to 51-14 romp over Mercyhurst
items.description: — Nick Sessions returned an interception 26 yards for a score on the first play of the game and Trey Hedden threw two touchdown passes to help New Mexico State roll to a 51-14 victory over FCS member Mercyhurst on Saturday night.

items.headline: Ashton Daniels has TD pass, TD run in Florida State's 34-17 win over New Mexico State
items.description: — Ashton Daniels passed for 202 yards and had a touchdown passing as well as rushing as Florida State defeated New Mexico State 34-17 in a season opener on Saturday.
